title: File storage now; revisit DB on multi-user
decision: Ship on tasks.json; a database is reconsidered only when multi-user lands.
rationale: Choosing the ENGINE is a two-way door (stays a DEC); the record SHAPE is one-way and was promoted to ADR-0001. Narrowed by SC-002 (2026-09-06): the export path may write a second file beside tasks.json — the CSV report — without that counting as a second store or reopening the engine choice.

title: Recurring tasks deferred behind OQ-001
decision: FR-006 stays out of the MVP until OQ-001 is answered.
rationale: Guessing missed-occurrence semantics risks building the wrong repeat model.
